$schema.description: JSON Schema URI for editor validation and autocompletion.

debug.description: Enable turn-by-turn routing debug notifications and history.

classifierModel.description: Classifier model used to categorize user intent. Accepts "auto" (uses first available Pi native classifier such as Jev, Clef, GPT-6 Luna, or llama.cpp classifier), a model alias from "models", a canonical "provider/model" reference, or an object with "model" and optional "thinking".

thinking.description: Thinking level when using a reasoning-capable chat LLM as classifier.

phaseBias.description: Stickiness of the current conversation phase (0.0 to 1.0). Higher values keep the router in the current tier more consistently.

maxSessionBudget.description: Maximum session spend in USD. Once exceeded, high-tier requests automatically downgrade to medium.

models.description: Map of reusable model aliases to model definitions and capability overrides.

rules.description: Custom keyword-based routing rules evaluated against the latest user prompt.

profiles.description: Map of virtual router profiles (exposed as router/<profile>). Each profile must define at least one tier.

contextWindow.description: Context window size in tokens (used when not reported by the model registry).

maxTokens.description: Maximum output tokens (used when not reported by the model registry).

reasoning.description: Whether the model supports reasoning/thinking levels.

thinkingLevels.description: Supported thinking levels for this model.

model.description: Canonical "provider/model" identifier or an alias from "models".

thinking.description: Default thinking level for this tier.

fallbacks.description: Ordered list of fallback models ("provider/model" or alias) if the primary model is unavailable or fails.

high.description: High tier: architecture, design, planning, complex debugging.

medium.description: Medium tier: standard implementation, multi-file edits, focused fixes.

low.description: Low tier: summaries, changelogs, formatting, quick lookups.

matches.description: Keyword or list of keywords to match case-insensitively against the user prompt.

reason.description: Optional human-readable reason displayed when this rule matches.
